output.summary: A bushy shrub native to Siberia and other parts of eastern Asia, especially China. It bears sweet-smelling white, pink or crimson flowers and shiny orange or red berries; eating the berries is not recommended because they can cause diarrhoea, vomiting and abdominal pain.
output.edibilityNote: The berries are mildly poisonous to humans; eating them may cause diarrhoea, vomiting and abdominal pain.
